description: An underwater scene in an oil-painting style, lit by sunbeams from the surface. A large, flat-finned creature with two grasping front appendages and a pair of stalked eyes hovers above a muddy seafloor. Around it, many small arthropods, including trilobites, crawl over the mud, and tube-shaped and branching sponge-like growths rise from the bottom. No text, frame or people are visible.
